basic_info.description: 2BR/2BA Top floor Jordan Park condo. Open modern floor plan with tall ceilings, east/west exposure, and many windows provides great natural light. Walk to Laurel Village and Clement Street restaurants, cafes and shopping, and Sunday farmer's market. En-suite master bedroom with French doors that lead to a private walk-out deck. Spa-like wet room with deep soaking tub. Impressive modern design and finishes throughout. Fisher & Paykel and Bertazzoni appliances. Wide plank oak floors and dual pane windows. Independent garage. Laundry in unit.
